title: Greer passes along an insider's contact (Jake Barber)

tellings.quote: So he says this gentleman uh knows what you saw but here's his contact information.

plain: Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a 300 foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says that around 2023 Steven Greer, a well-known UFO activist, gave him a man's contact details. According to Herrera, Greer told him "this gentleman knows what you saw", and the man was Jake Barber. If true, it would mean an insider already knew about Herrera's sighting.
